:::{#def-optimization-algorithm}
#### Optimization algorithm

With $(f, F)$ as in @def-objective-function,
an **optimization algorithm**
[@wikipedia_mathematical_optimization]
is a step-by-step procedure that, given $(f, F)$,
returns a feasible point $\vx^\dagger \in F$ intended to make $f(\vx^\dagger)$ small.

:::
